configuration: Sarvam Vision 2.1; author-operated text-block recognition comparison published September 24, 2026.
dataset_scope: 6,909 text blocks: 6,609 from 22 Indic languages plus 300 English; published comparison lists 22 Indic language scores
sample_unit: text blocks in released test split
evaluation_method: Reported word accuracy; dataset defines 100 × (1 − WER), with normalized text and separate valid-only metrics.
visible_context: Recognition only; 6,909-block public corpus. 22 Indic language scores; English score and headline denominator unspecified. Excluded from rank.
note: The release reports overall 87.39 and the 22 Indic language scores. It provides no English score or explicit all-output versus valid-only denominator; no missing English value is imputed. The dataset scorer normalizes text, caps per-sample CER/WER at 1.0 and separately flags repetitive outputs. No inference is made about the exact release-table scorer options.
